name: kohakublueleaf/kohaku-tt
title: Kohaku-TT: community kernel library runs the Moss-Image base model on a Tenstorrent P150a
summary: A developer wrote his own PyTorch-side kernel library for Tenstorrent cards and used it to run the Moss-Image base image model on a P150a, filling a gap in official torch support for that hardware.
